message:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Sophie plans to study physics. The Osaka Town Hall is located in Reșița. Also, Orion Robotics is located in Timișoara. Bohdan trains CS Leipzig.

Carpathia Energy did not publish The Salt Road. Adaeze is the spouse of Mehmet. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me.

Mr Romero is married to Ștefan Diaconu. Also, Ghiță is married to Florin. The Tuesday board meeting takes place at the Lviv Philharmonic. Joaquín doesn't fly to Chengdu. Ovidiu does not plan to go to the harvest festival.

Mihai has an allergy to peanuts. Also, Teodora Vlădescu is allergic to dust mites. Medeea wants to learn computer science. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Roxana is not allergic to bee stings. Also, Krzysztof has an allergy to penicillin.

Blue Harbor Media is a supplier of Delta Print. Also, Nordwind Systems is a supplier of Vertex Analytics. The analytics pipeline does not depend on the login service. Also, the mail server does not depend on the backup cluster. Petru checked out Winter in Maramureș. Also, Elif Demir borrowed The Last Ferry. Atelier Weber sells garden furniture.

Thomas does not go to Deva Technical College. Felix has an allergy to pollen. Also, Priya isn't allergic to latex. The spring book fair takes place at the Old Mill Hall. Also, the town hall debate takes place at the Botanical Garden in Novi Sad. Achieng looks after the payroll database. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. The Botanical Garden in Pitești isn't located in Sibiu.

Nikos Georgiou trains the Slatina Wolves. A work permit requires an ID card. Also, a driving licence requires a medical certificate. Hanoi Logistics is a supplier of Bergen Logistics. Oprea & Partners does not sell baby food. I hope you are having a good day.

Ms Bălan reports to Mykola. Also, João reports to Kavya. Parisa looks after the VPN gateway. Also, Arjun Iyer looks after the booking app. Atelier Munteanu sells winter tyres. Chioma is a child of Ilinca. Mr Florea plans to study drawing.

Oksana doesn't want to learn biology. Mr Szabó goes to Izmir Music Academy. Levente Farkas reports to Grace. The Nairobi Philharmonic is located in Debrecen. Also, the Botanical Garden in Debrecen is located in Bacău. Małgorzata treats Traian. Also, Mr Martin treats Natalia.

Astrid Nilsen looks after the search index. My coffee went cold while I was typing this. The inventory API relies on the payments gateway. Horia goes to Sighișoara Technical College. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Simona does not teach Spanish. Also, Ms Wright gives classes in mathematics.

Kraków Logistics does not employ Wei.

Now, what I need to know:
So where did the product launch take place?
So where did Xiaoling fly?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

Fatima gives classes in geography. Also, Alejandro teaches drawing.

In what period did Victor live in Timișoara?
Here's what I know: Aiko Sato trained Rapid Lisbon from July 1, 2018 until October 1, 2022. Do you know if she trained Rapid Lisbon on 2018-07-01?

- answer my emails

What I actually want to know: So was Mr Tóth the spouse of Youssef during 2021? Tell me where Alina Dumitrescu is based. Other than Oliver, I wonder who wants to learn Spanish. Honestly, does the reporting dashboard not rely on the analytics pipeline?

I only have a few minutes before my next call. Csaba trains Olimpia Călărași. Mihai flies to Izmir. Also, Chinedu doesn't fly to Focșani. Răzvan Voicu does not report to Youssef.

Atelier Taylor sells phone cases. The Passport Office in Brașov issues a birth certificate. Also, a land title extract is issued by the Valencia Tax Office. Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Tisa Textiles published Soups of Transylvania. Manon flies to Bălți. Cosmin flies to Tulcea. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Ms Lazăr reports to Karim. The VPN gateway relies on the backup cluster. Also, the payments gateway doesn't rely on the booking app. Mr Souza checked out The Clockmaker's Daughter. Also, Lukas checked out A Short History of Bridges.

Mr Romero has an allergy to lactose. Also, Petru is not allergic to ibuprofen. Blue Harbor Media doesn't sell LED bulbs. Andreea is not the spouse of Xiaoling.

Mr Wilson plans to study computer science. The wedding reception takes place at the Chișinău Philharmonic. Nadiya Shevchenko trains Slatina United. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Hiroshi Watanabe has an allergy to cat hair.

Min-jun is allergic to shellfish. Also, Corina Moldovan is allergic to peanuts. The harvest festival doesn't take place at the Sighișoara Arena. Also, the code review session does not take place at the Thessaloniki Arena. The Baia Mare Arena is located in Bacău.

Nils Lindqvist plans to study piano. Also, Ghiță wants to learn drawing. Julien Moreau trains CS Szeged. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Zofia gives classes in geography.

Chen gives classes in physics. The Leeds Tax Office issues a passport. Also, a medical certificate is issued by the Lagos Land Office. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. Zoltán treats Jun. I only have a few minutes before my next call.

Joaquín intends to attend the spring book fair. Also, Zsófia plans to go to the charity run. Katrin Becker flies to Pune. The Galați Town Hall issues a tax clearance certificate. The Târgu Mureș Land Office issues a fire safety approval. Also, the Passport Office in Târgu Mureș doesn't issue a work permit. My coffee went cold while I was typing this.

Mykola is a child of Florică. Also, Irina is a child of Veaceslav Cebotari. Quang is on Olimpia Galați. Also, Giorgos plays for the Montreal Wolves. Levente does not treat Emeka Eze. Also, Toma doesn't treat Matei. Nour treats Vikram. Also, Chloe does not treat Doinița. Oana plans to study biology. Also, Tatiana wants to learn mathematics.

Buzău Logistics is located in Arad. I will try to keep the rest short. Atelier Hughes sells second-hand laptops.

Taras has an allergy to dust mites. Atelier Clarke is not a supplier of Atelier Manole. Chișinău Logistics is a supplier of Sibiu Logistics. My coffee went cold while I was typing this.

A few questions, then: Is it true that the mail server relies on the login service? Here's what I know: Mr Lefèvre gets to work by ferry. I wonder how Sofía goes to work. How come Ms Sharma has the flu? So how many venues does the parents' evening take place at? Could you check if Orion Robotics employs Ruxandra?

Talk soon!

Neagu & Partners isn't a supplier of Vertex Analytics. The code review session takes place at the Old Mill Hall. Also, the harvest festival takes place at the Botanical Garden in Cluj-Napoca. Rafael borrowed Winter in Maramureș. Also, Liam checked out The Clockmaker's Daughter. Mr Zhao is allergic to lactose.

Ms Rădulescu is not on the Plovdiv Wolves. Iancu is on the Tampere Wolves. Also, Sorin plays for the Osaka Wolves. Mr Mocanu flies to Lviv. Also, Alexandru Vlădescu flies to Deva. Hughes & Partners is a supplier of Ploiești Logistics. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what.

Bianca Diaconu trains Olimpia Iași. Wright & Partners employs Mirela. Otieno doesn't go to Târgu Mureș Arts High School. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Sârbu & Partners is a supplier of Sibiu Logistics.

Mr Tănase goes to Orhei Technical College. Also, Ms Moreau goes to Lagos Music Academy. Pablo doesn't look after the payroll database.

The inventory API doesn't rely on the payments gateway. Also, the backup cluster does not rely on the billing service. Tunde wants to learn biology. Yan Liu treats Kamau.

Dariush reports to Felix. Ms Moldovan trains the Szeged Falcons. Bălan & Partners employs Jonas. Julien teaches German. Traian flies to Novi Sad. Also, Ilinca doesn't fly to Bălți.

Liviu Anghel has an allergy to strawberries. Also, Marius is allergic to latex.

Things I still have to do today:

- water the plants
- book the train tickets
- answer my emails
- call the plumber
- pay the phone bill

What I actually want to know: Any idea which town the Zalău Language School is located in? How many times was the mail server out of service? Fact-check: Sigrid goes to Cahul Arts High School. So where did Lars fly? Here's what I know: Megan Bennett settles the bill with a debit card. Any idea how Veaceslav settles the bill? Is it true that Craiova Children's Clinic is located in Buzău?

Also, Bistrița Arts High School isn't located in Busan.
The login service does not depend on the reporting dashboard.
Also, the VPN gateway relies on the analytics pipeline.
The Osaka Language School is located in Suceava.
Also, the Kraków Tax Office is located in Zalău.
George Wilson does not intend to attend the parents' evening.
Also, Ms Popa plans to go to the town hall debate.
Teodora Pătrașcu flies to Cluj-Napoca.
I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious.
Nordwind Systems employs Grace Hughes.
Vertex Analytics published Soups of Transylvania.
This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest.
Sânziana is the spouse of Sorin.
Also, Lukas Hoffmann is married to Mr Florea.
Pune Arts High School is located in Alba Iulia.
Also, the Old Mill Hall is located in Bălți.
Thanks for your patience with all my questions.
Wojciech does not plan to study physical education.
Also, Joaquín does not plan to study physics.
A residence certificate requires an ID card.
The booking app depends on the payments gateway.
Also, the inventory API relies on the search index.
Giorgos doesn't go to Ploiești Music Academy.
Also, Yuki goes to Szeged Technical College.
So where did the product launch take place?
Suppose Manon has an allergy to gluten.
Any chance she is allergic to gluten?
Oana is a child of Erik.
Is it the case that Erik is a child of Oana?
find out who looks after the backup cluster.
Explain to me why the mail server is down.
find out which town Brightfield Foods is located in.
Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

message:
My coffee went cold while I was typing this. Nicolae is on CS Leipzig. Ms Sánchez plans to go to the town hall debate. Seo-yeon is a parent of Ionuț and Larisa is a parent of Victor.

Kaveh Farahani is the spouse of Vlad. Plus, Ayşe is married to Medeea. Mr Hughes studies at the Baia Mare Language School. Carpathia Energy doesn't supply Atelier Ungureanu; Orion Robotics buys from Blue Harbor Media. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. Viorel Enache is not a parent of Mircea.

The flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Mathieu. Plus, the recording studio belongs to Samuel. My coffee went cold while I was typing this. Ananya Iyer gives classes in geography. A criminal record certificate is required for a driving licence. Brightfield Foods sells olive oil.

Mr Sârbu intends to attend the photography workshop. A fire safety approval is issued by the Nairobi Tax Office; an ID card is issued by the Passport Office in Focșani. Delta Print buys from Atelier Schmidt. Plus, Vertex Analytics supplies Brașov Logistics. Burak is on Olimpia Iași. João teaches biology; Ingrid does not teach mathematics. I will try to keep the rest short.

The search index depends on the booking app. Tisa Textiles published Notes from the Night Train. Plus, Suceava Logistics published Winter in Maramureș. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help.

Georgiana teaches drawing, and Mr Suzuki teaches history. Beatriz is not based in Botoșani. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. The payments gateway relies on the backup cluster.

So, my questions: Other than Kenji, I'm trying to find out who is a parent of Ms Mureșan. Moritz raises Jun. Honestly, does Jun raise Moritz? Sorin is the boss of Thảo. — is it correct that Thảo manages Sorin?

Talk soon!

We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. The inventory API depends on the search index. Tisa Textiles supplies Greenline Transport. Owen is not the coach of the Hanoi Wolves. Thanks for your patience with all my questions.

Elif lives in Târgu Mureș and Kamau is based in Focșani. Letters to a Young Engineer was written by Paula Oprea. Plus, Erik is the author of A Short History of Bridges. Samuel does not intend to attend the spring book fair. My coffee went cold while I was typing this. Ms Manole plays for Rapid Bacău. Plus, Quang Trần plays for Sighișoara United. Slatina Logistics supplies Brightfield Foods. Plus, Nordwind Systems buys from Orion Robotics.

Medeea Tănase is on the Chișinău Wolves. Ngozi goes to the harvest festival. Mr Adeyemi doesn't have a job at Atelier Dumitrescu. Diana gives classes in Spanish. The garage behind the block belongs to Youssef.

The booking app does not depend on the billing service. Plus, the payments gateway does not depend on the backup cluster. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Radu travels to Suceava. Otieno is not treated by Vikram. Vasile Gheorghiu manages Jessica Wilson. Ruxandra is not treated by Olena, and Sofía is the doctor of Yuki Tanaka.

Manon is the owner of the bakery on the corner. Plus, the recording studio belongs to Ms Martin. The login service doesn't depend on the analytics pipeline. Xiaoling Wang is the doctor of Emre. A criminal record certificate is issued by the Recife Tax Office.

Delta Print buys from Nagy & Partners. Plus, Szeged Logistics buys from Tóth & Partners. Taylor & Partners sells winter tyres. Plus, Iași Logistics carries bicycle parts.

Things I still have to do today:
- buy groceries
- book the train tickets
- call the plumber

A few questions, then: Apart from Constantin, I need to know who teaches mathematics. Do you know how Bogdan Florea gets to work? I'm trying to find out which company Layla has a job at.

Talk soon!

message:
Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Csaba trains the Galați Wolves. Also, Min-jun Kim trains Olimpia Osaka. Giorgos has borrowed The Salt Road. Also, Teodora borrowed Notes from the Night Train. A birth certificate is issued by the Buzău Town Hall.

The Tuesday board meeting takes place at the Botanical Garden in Kraków. The jazz evening takes place at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Ms Gupta lives in Suceava. Also, Diana is based in Brașov.

Nils is a child of Lucian. Blue Harbor Media is not a supplier of Brightfield Foods.

What I actually want to know: Do you know if Lars Johansson looks after the analytics pipeline? Not counting Mr Wright, please find out who Lukas Wagner is a child of. Any idea who lives in Lisbon? Any chance Arjun Reddy wrote The Clockmaker's Daughter? Not counting Joaquín López, please find out who trains Olimpia Nairobi. Here's what I know: Rachel pays with a bank transfer. Any idea how Ms Romero settles the bill?

Cheers, and have a nice evening.

message:
It has been a hectic week on my side. Ștefania is the owner of the plot of land by the river and the bakery on the corner belongs to Ms Voicu. A work permit requires a criminal record certificate. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Mr Müller works under Parisa.

Carpathia Energy supplies Atelier Bălan and Brightfield Foods supplies Delta Print. Hyun-woo is the owner of the garage behind the block, and Mr Odhiambo is the owner of the old sailing boat. Esmeralda works under Mr Romero.

Katrin is not on Olimpia Ploiești; Aurelia plays for Olimpia Montreal. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Sânziana is the boss of Mr Clarke. The booking app depends on the payments gateway. Plus, the inventory API depends on the billing service. Rafael is the coach of Rapid Novi Sad, and Hassan coaches Rapid Tampere. Rémi is responsible for the search index.

Vaslui Logistics isn't based in Thessaloniki. Leeds Logistics carries olive oil. The wedding reception is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Plus, the spring book fair is held at the Old Mill Hall.

The backup cluster does not depend on the mail server. The jazz evening is held at the Constanța Philharmonic.

A few questions, then: I'm trying to find out who published A Short History of Bridges. Check this: Olena goes to the harvest festival. Tell me which team Anna-Lena is the coach of. Given that Emre teaches chemistry, does he teach chemistry? Verify the claim that a fire safety approval isn't issued by the Baia Mare Tax Office. Aditya was married to Haruka Sato from October 1, 2021 to November 1, 2024. He was the spouse of Haruka Sato on the 1st of October 2021, right?

message:
I am new to all of this, so apologies if it is obvious. Nils goes to Craiova Music Academy. Also, Teodora goes to the Glasgow Language School. Fatima plays for the Buzău Wolves. Also, Paloma plays for Olimpia Osaka. Kavya lives in Alexandria.

Ionuț is a child of Yuki. Also, Diego is a child of Mr Walker. Răzvan reports to Chinedu. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. A passport requires a land title extract. Orion Robotics carries sourdough bread. Also, Rusu & Partners sells herbal tea.

The Tuesday board meeting takes place at the Botanical Garden in Slatina. Also, the product launch takes place at the Galați Philharmonic. Greenline Transport employs Otilia. Delta Print does not sell LED bulbs. Also, Nordwind Systems sells second-hand laptops. Marius is married to Nour. Also, Théo is married to Aiko.

Lisbon Logistics is not a supplier of Blue Harbor Media. Natalia does not go to Botoșani Arts High School. Also, Jürgen goes to Dobre Primary School. Zsófia is allergic to lactose. Iulia teaches biology. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Mehmet gives classes in physical education. Larisa doesn't give classes in history. The regional chess tournament does not take place at the Botanical Garden in Bergen. Also, the town hall debate does not take place at the Montreal Arena. Erik doesn't have an allergy to strawberries. I hope you are having a good day.

Seo-yeon gives classes in computer science. Smaranda Vlădescu has borrowed The Last Ferry. Wojciech treats Thiago. Atelier Clarke is not a supplier of Pitești Logistics. Mr Popescu does not borrow The Glass Orchard. Also, Tunde checked out The Clockmaker's Daughter.

Chloé wrote Letters to a Young Engineer. Botond lives in Constanța. Mr Moldovan treats Daniel. Giorgos looks after the VPN gateway. Also, Raluca looks after the mail server. A criminal record certificate is required for a driving licence. Also, a residence certificate requires an ID card.

Now, what I need to know:
Any idea what Tisa Textiles sells?
Fact-check: the login service depends on the payroll database.

message:
Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. Samuel is based in Ploiești. Vertex Analytics carries sourdough bread, and Glasgow Logistics carries second-hand laptops. Blue Harbor Media supplies Șerban & Partners. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush.

Traian plans to study mathematics. Delta Print supplies Brightfield Foods. Doina is married to Bogdan. A work permit requires an ID card. Let me give you some background first. Adaeze plans to go to the regional chess tournament; Andreea intends to attend the photography workshop.

Chloe is treated by Mr Toma, and Ms Ciobanu isn't the doctor of Oliver. Thảo isn't married to Rubina. Rohan takes part in the charity run. I hope you are having a good day. Ms Mwangi is based in Tulcea and Takumi Watanabe lives in Hanoi. Hiroshi is the doctor of Mr Clarke and Jun is the doctor of Hugo Lefèvre.

Beatriz Souza goes to the code review session. Orion Robotics doesn't carry baby food; Tisa Textiles carries herbal tea. The payments gateway doesn't rely on the booking app, and the backup cluster depends on the search index. Ms Iyer does not borrow Notes from the Night Train. Greenline Transport supplies Balogh & Partners; Carpathia Energy buys from Atelier Nagy.

Tamás gives classes in Spanish. A birth certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Montreal. Elena doesn't want to learn geography. Plus, Ovidiu wants to learn chemistry. Erik is married to Mr Oliveira.

Farkas & Partners sells bicycle parts and Neagu & Partners doesn't sell printer ink. The billing service depends on the inventory API. Mr Popescu has borrowed Letters to a Young Engineer. Chioma checked out The Glass Orchard. Ms Enache is based in Szeged.

The Old Mill Hall doesn't host the town hall debate. The VPN gateway relies on the reporting dashboard. The payroll database depends on the mail server. Plus, the analytics pipeline depends on the login service. Mykola doesn't intend to attend the parents' evening. Felix is on Valencia United.

Ji-woo doesn't raise Lena, and Gheorghe Căpraru is a parent of Dragoș. Schmidt & Partners published The Salt Road and Wright & Partners published Soups of Transylvania. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Rahul is based in Alba Iulia. Plus, Mr Nasser lives in Craiova.

Kaveh is the coach of Olimpia Lisbon, and Carmen Iordache coaches the Lisbon Wolves. Kostas teaches biology, and Simona Mureșan does not teach drawing. Jessica Smith travels to Kraków. Plus, Octavian visits Brașov.

Cătălin does not give classes in physics. Larissa is treated by Iurie. Vasile is the coach of the Slatina Falcons. Julien Martin lives in Oradea.

Raluca Crăciun is treated by Viorel Moldovan. Priya is allergic to peanuts and Cristina Oprea has an allergy to shellfish. Atelier Kovács carries olive oil. Dimitra is the coach of the Izmir Falcons and Roxana is the coach of the Pitești Wolves.

Rémi raises Hassan and Sânziana Munteanu is a parent of Rachel. Taras lives in Baia Mare. Ștefania Anghel is the spouse of Burak and Ms Mocanu is the spouse of Mr Stan.

Lisbon Logistics buys from Nagy & Partners.

A few questions, then: Background: Krzysztof manages Moritz. Question: I need to know if Moritz is the boss of Krzysztof. Out of curiosity, how many documents does the Târgu Mureș Land Office issue?

Thanks in advance!

My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. Ms Kim visits Lagos. A driving licence is issued by the Zalău Tax Office. The charity run is held at the Old Mill Hall. Anyway, back to what I actually wanted to ask. Cătălin is a parent of Levente; Camille raises Javier Romero.

Mădălina Iordache is married to Mr Martínez. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. Owen travels to Iași; Ms Sârbu travels to Chișinău. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Simona Crăciun is enrolled at Novi Sad Technical College, and Alina doesn't study at Târgu Mureș Technical College. Ms Tehrani does not maintain the billing service, and Andrei is not responsible for the booking app. The bakery on the corner does not belong to Burak. Mei Li is employed by Brightfield Foods; Ingrid has a job at Arad Logistics.

Delta Print supplies Blue Harbor Media. João lives in Tampere. Plus, Zeynep lives in Sibiu. Mr Reddy wants to learn history; Sofía plans to study Spanish.

A criminal record certificate is required for a work permit. Ms Martin travels to Deva. Aditya is not treated by Hiroshi. Plus, Ananya Patel is the doctor of Jürgen.

Liam lives in Nairobi. The photography workshop is held at the Porto Philharmonic. The red Dacia belongs to Tariq, and the recording studio belongs to Layla Saleh. Oksana travels to Szeged.

Vasile is based in Kraków. Ion gives classes in mathematics. A fire safety approval is issued by the Bacău Land Office and a tax clearance certificate is issued by the Leeds Land Office. It has been a hectic week on my side.

Mr Zhang is the doctor of Ioana and Roxana isn't the doctor of Jessica. Osaka Logistics supplies Wagner & Partners, and Greenline Transport buys from Gheorghiu & Partners. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Takumi has an allergy to peanuts.

Erik is a parent of Rafael Oliveira. I tried to sort this out myself but got confused. The payments gateway relies on the reporting dashboard. Plus, the analytics pipeline relies on the VPN gateway. Atelier Nagy sells printer ink. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush.

Things I still have to do today:
- water the plants
- pay the phone bill
- return the library books

Kenji Suzuki was enrolled at Sighișoara Technical College on January 2, 2019? I was wondering whether Chloé does not study at Constanța Arts High School. What is the reason that Vlad is cleared for the lab?

Răzvan trains Olimpia Bistrița.

Florin doesn't plan to study drawing. Also, Alejandro wants to learn physics. I will try to keep the rest short. Florică treats Lukas. Also, Min-jun treats Bohdan. Bogdan Barbu wants to learn computer science.

Arjun is the spouse of Mykola Shevchenko. Also, Takumi is married to Taras. I have a dentist appointment later, so I am in a bit of a rush. Nordwind Systems published Soups of Transylvania. Also, Nagy & Partners published Notes from the Night Train. Elif reports to Kamau. Also, Chinedu Eze does not report to Teodora. Thanks for your patience with all my questions.

Brightfield Foods published Letters to a Young Engineer. Also, Atelier Ionescu did not publish The Clockmaker's Daughter. Seo-yeon looks after the payments gateway. Also, Dimitra looks after the search index. A building permit doesn't require an ID card. Élodie is a child of Viorica. Also, Quang Phạm is a child of Théo.

Busan Logistics isn't a supplier of Carpathia Energy. Also, Lisbon Logistics is a supplier of Vertex Analytics. Alexandria Logistics is located in Oradea.

Things I still have to do today:
- answer my emails
- pay the phone bill
- call the plumber
- buy groceries
- water the plants
- finish the slides

So, my questions: Here's what I know: Mr Silva attends the Tuesday board meeting; Olena attends the Tuesday board meeting. Do you know if Nour doesn't attend the Tuesday board meeting? Suppose Meera owns the holiday cottage in Bran. Do you know if she owns the holiday cottage in Bran? Fact-check: Thomas Taylor does not train the Buzău Wolves. Any idea which system depends on the mail server? Fact-check: Karim is the spouse of Mircea.

Bear with me, I am thinking out loud here. Atelier Varga supplies Orion Robotics. Jessica Taylor plans to study geography and Mateo plans to study drawing. Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one.

Medeea is a parent of Mr Smith. Zeynep goes to the regional chess tournament, and Hannah goes to the town hall debate. The Quiet Harbour was written by Linh. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow.

Chloe has an allergy to ibuprofen. Vertex Analytics sells second-hand laptops, and Nordwind Systems sells printer ink. I am writing this on my phone, so bear with me. Hiroshi lives in Nairobi; Vlad is based in Constanța. Łukasz does not coach the Lyon Falcons; Ștefania Crăciun is the coach of the Sibiu Wolves. Let me give you some background first.

Elif plays for Rapid Sighișoara. Daria doesn't live in Baia Mare. An ID card isn't required for a work permit. The backup cluster depends on the search index. Greenline Transport doesn't carry sourdough bread.

Achieng visits Ploiești, and Hugo travels to Oradea. Ayşe doesn't have a job at Munteanu & Partners. Irina visits Slatina.

A fire safety approval is issued by the Passport Office in Hanoi. Plus, a tax clearance certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Călărași.

Things I still have to do today:
- call the plumber
- finish the slides
- buy groceries
- water the plants
- return the library books

So, my questions:
So was Oana Ungureanu the coach of Rapid Debrecen during 2021?
Quick question: was Jürgen based in Zalău in 2020?
Can you tell me who is the spouse of Yuki?
Quick one: where was the harvest festival held?
Hi! Aditya is allergic to pollen, and Mădălina Lazăr is allergic to pollen, and Dorin Diaconu is allergic to pollen. I wonder if Liviu does not have an allergy to pollen.
Okay so Oluwaseun Adeyemi is the boss of Réka. Réka manages Oluwaseun Adeyemi, correct?

message:
Let me give you some background first. Priya plays for CS Tulcea. Plus, Hyun-woo plays for Chișinău United. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. Rahul Gupta takes part in the spring book fair and Ana goes to the harvest festival.

Saint Luke Hospital isn't based in Sighișoara. Ms Șerban is treated by Rubina Lăutaru. I hope you are having a good day.

Chloé is the coach of Rapid Baia Mare. Plus, Kostas coaches CS Târgu Mureș. The Slatina Town Hall issues a work permit. Blue Harbor Media sells baby food. Ji-woo plans to go to the charity run. Katrin plans to study German.

The regional chess tournament is held at the Călărași Arena. Larisa coaches the Pitești Falcons, and Ovidiu coaches the Szeged Wolves. The payments gateway relies on the billing service. Plus, the payroll database doesn't rely on the login service. The Debrecen Tax Office does not issue a medical certificate. Levente has an allergy to penicillin, and Otieno has an allergy to latex. Paweł visits Nairobi; Mr Toma visits Alba Iulia.

Jun is on Rapid Botoșani. Ayşe manages Alina. Orion Robotics published Notes from the Night Train, and Atelier Ungureanu published The Quiet Harbour.

Smaranda is the spouse of Daria; Yuki Tanaka is married to Ingrid. Camille is the spouse of Krzysztof. Rémi teaches mathematics.

Can gives classes in drawing and Olena gives classes in geography. A residence certificate is issued by the Passport Office in Arad; the Tampere Tax Office issues a tax clearance certificate. Jack does not have a job at Carpathia Energy. A driving licence requires a criminal record certificate.

Turner & Partners supplies Cluj-Napoca Logistics and Debrecen Logistics buys from Valencia Logistics. Katalin has a job at Atelier Vlădescu. Plus, Irina Bălan works for Diaconu & Partners. The Passport Office in Piatra Neamț issues a fire safety approval. Owen raises Doina. I will try to keep the rest short.

Hiroshi Suzuki works for Atelier Weber. It has been a hectic week on my side. Atelier Nagy sells second-hand laptops; Focșani Logistics does not sell olive oil. The Tuesday board meeting is held at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Plus, the Szeged Arena hosts the parents' evening. Anca goes to the product launch.

Noah Wright works under Valentina. Brașov Logistics sells phone cases. Becker & Partners carries school uniforms.

Tatiana is married to Simona. Cosmin Crăciun travels to Kraków. Enikő works for Atelier Florea. Corina is treated by Tariq and Emeka is the doctor of Oliver.

Mr Gheorghiu visits Bistrița. The Constanța Philharmonic is in Bălți. Mocanu & Partners is based in Sibiu.

A few questions, then:
Verify the claim that Nordwind Systems does not carry herbal tea.
Could you check who is allergic to shellfish?
Do you know who Mădălina is married to?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

message:
Sorry in advance, this is going to be a long one. Paloma intends to attend the parents' evening. Also, Veaceslav intends to attend the Tuesday board meeting. Beatriz looks after the payroll database.

The backup cluster depends on the analytics pipeline. Hao teaches piano. Ardeleanu & Partners is a supplier of Reșița Logistics.

Bistrița Riverside Clinic is located in Timișoara. Also, Tampere Riverside Clinic is located in Valencia. Șerban & Partners published Soups of Transylvania. Cristina Oprea doesn't fly to Baia Mare. Also, Bohdan does not fly to Izmir.

Lucian plans to go to the product launch. Also, Théo intends to attend the spring book fair. I hope you are having a good day. A land title extract is not required for a work permit. Also, a passport requires a medical certificate.

Iancu Ciobanu looks after the login service. The Ploiești Town Hall isn't located in Bălți. Andrei is married to Thiago. Otieno gives classes in computer science. Thomas plans to study chemistry.

Blue Harbor Media does not employ Jonas. Also, Greenline Transport employs Karim. A birth certificate is required for a building permit. Also, a residence certificate does not require a criminal record certificate. Yan has an allergy to lactose.

A driving licence requires an ID card. Tisa Textiles published Winter in Maramureș. Parisa plays for the Oradea Falcons. Kavya treats Arjun Sharma. Ms Mocanu has an allergy to dust mites. Also, Ildikó has an allergy to shellfish.

Nikos doesn't give classes in geography. Ethan trains the Montreal Falcons. Also, Amira Saleh trains CS Vaslui. Mr Johansson plans to go to the charity run. Farkas & Partners published The Quiet Harbour. The booking app does not depend on the reporting dashboard.

Natalia Cebotari trains CS Alba Iulia. Bistrița Logistics sells phone cases. Viorica Vlădescu plans to study drawing. Also, Kenji wants to learn German. Barbu & Partners published The Last Ferry. Also, Fekete & Partners published The Glass Orchard.

Things I still have to do today:
- buy groceries
- answer my emails
- book the train tickets

Now, what I need to know: Here's what I know: Tudor Moldovan goes to Alba Iulia Music Academy. Could you check if Botond Balogh goes to Alba Iulia Music Academy? Not counting Achieng, please find out who plays for Rapid Porto. So where did the code review session take place? Any idea since when Nistor & Partners employs Marius? When exactly did Tunde Adeyemi teach physical education?

That is all the background I have for now.

message:
Thanks for your patience with all my questions. Mr Bennett is the author of The Glass Orchard. Plus, The Clockmaker's Daughter was written by Maria. The Old Mill Hall is based in Zalău. Honestly, I keep losing track of who does what.

Seo-yeon is enrolled at the Tulcea Language School. Delta Print carries sourdough bread, and Nordwind Systems carries printer ink. Brightfield Foods sells second-hand laptops. Hiroshi Suzuki is the owner of the blue van. Plus, Dorin is not the owner of the old sailing boat.

Gheorghe visits Glasgow. Ingrid Nilsen is the coach of CS Szeged. Wanjiru doesn't intend to attend the harvest festival; Ioana doesn't intend to attend the code review session. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day.

Octavian gives classes in German. Plus, Laura teaches Spanish. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Linh Phạm is enrolled at Lyon Arts High School and Constantin studies at Ardeleanu Primary School. The red Dacia belongs to Vasile and the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Haruka.

Lin works under Dimitra; Doinița manages Léa Moreau. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day. Mr Çelik is treated by Jonas. Kamau is treated by Mr Guțu, and Zeynep is the doctor of Floarea. The weather here has been awful all week.

Larisa plans to study biology; Ion plans to study mathematics. The Botanical Garden in Botoșani is in Montreal. Plus, Plovdiv Music Academy is in Constanța. Lucía Navarro is treated by Layla. Cosmin Rusu raises Moritz.

Ștefania doesn't maintain the booking app. Liviu does not travel to Vaslui, and Małgorzata visits Lagos. The Botanical Garden in Novi Sad isn't in Leeds. I only have a few minutes before my next call. The billing service doesn't rely on the inventory API. Ms Manole is on Izmir United.

The Slatina Arena hosts the parents' evening. I will probably forget half of this by tomorrow. The garage behind the block belongs to Oana.

The Bergen Tax Office issues a work permit. Tatiana is on the Tampere Wolves. Burak Kaya is not on the Botoșani Wolves. Plus, Rafael is on Olimpia Târgu Mureș. My manager wants a summary by the end of the day.

Hassan plans to study geography. A criminal record certificate is issued by the Bacău Tax Office. Andrei does not want to learn history. Baia Mare Logistics supplies Atelier Clarke and Toma & Partners does not buy from Atelier Barbu.

So, my questions: I was wondering whether Sofía coached Rapid Pune in 2021. Out of curiosity, where was the charity run held? Verify the claim that João is married to Roxana Munteanu. I'd like to know where Varga & Partners is.

Talk soon!

message:
I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. A fire safety approval is issued by the Reșița Tax Office. Emma isn't on the Galați Wolves. Also, Oliver Hughes is on the Piatra Neamț Falcons. Brightfield Foods employs Mr Bennett. Also, Nordwind Systems employs Attila. A passport isn't issued by the Orhei Tax Office. Hiroshi wrote The Salt Road. Also, Oksana wrote Winter in Maramureș.

Yuki looks after the mail server. The Bălți Dental Practice is located in Craiova. Also, Izmir Music Academy is located in Bacău. Ghiță Stoian trains Rapid Tulcea. Olivia wrote The Quiet Harbour.

Bohdan wrote The Last Ferry. Carmen has borrowed Letters to a Young Engineer. Atelier Wagner carries LED bulbs. Also, Vertex Analytics sells phone cases.

Chinedu Adeyemi is allergic to bee stings. Also, Zoltán has an allergy to lactose. A driving licence requires a birth certificate. Veaceslav trains the Lisbon Falcons. Kavya reports to Mirela. I will try to keep the rest short. Hao plans to study physics. Also, Hassan Mansour plans to study physical education.

The jazz evening takes place at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Also, the spring book fair does not take place at the Busan Philharmonic. Nadiya teaches drawing. Also, Lukas teaches history. The Oradea Land Office isn't located in Plovdiv. Atelier Șerban is a supplier of Pitești Logistics. Also, Balogh & Partners is a supplier of Blue Harbor Media.

The town hall debate takes place at the Chișinău Arena. I have been meaning to ask about this for a while. Meera Sharma trains the Slatina Wolves. Also, Matei Rădulescu trains Călărași United. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. Larisa Anghel trains the Leeds Wolves. Also, Iulia trains Rapid Suceava. The booking app depends on the search index. Also, the backup cluster depends on the billing service.

Toma Stan is on Olimpia Bergen. The photography workshop takes place at the Old Mill Hall. Lars attends the wedding reception. Katrin Becker is allergic to penicillin. Atelier Weber sells garden furniture. Also, Orion Robotics sells second-hand laptops. Oana attends the charity run. Also, Mr Johansson attends the harvest festival.

Kenji trains Rapid Constanța. Alexandru is not allergic to latex. The Chișinău Town Hall issues a land title extract. A medical certificate is issued by the Bistrița Land Office. Also, the Montreal Town Hall issues a residence certificate.

Manon doesn't play for the Kraków Falcons. Also, Moritz is not on Rapid Arad. Elena trains Rapid Lisbon. Also, Ms Căpraru trains Olimpia Vaslui. Mr Lazăr has an allergy to shellfish.

Mr Santos does not want to learn chemistry. Joaquín Martínez reports to Elif. Also, Yan reports to Florin. Dorin doesn't give classes in biology. Jun treats Petru.

A few questions, then: How come Owen doesn't have access to the lab? Not counting Chen, please find out who gives classes in piano. Here's what I know: Natalia Guțu attends the parents' evening; Zsófia Varga attends the parents' evening. Could you check if Tunde doesn't attend the parents' evening?

Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.

It has been a hectic week on my side. Costin is married to Rachel. Plus, Ananya is married to Mathieu. Takumi is based in Sibiu. Brightfield Foods sells olive oil. Plus, Țurcanu & Partners carries printer ink. Greenline Transport carries winter tyres.

Anna-Lena Müller coaches Rapid Chișinău. Blue Harbor Media published Winter in Maramureș. Bianca goes to the spring book fair. Rohan is not a parent of Emeka and Brândușa isn't a parent of Cristina.

Pătrașcu & Partners published The Clockmaker's Daughter and Orion Robotics published Notes from the Night Train. The code review session is held at the Szeged Philharmonic. We had a power cut this morning, which did not help. The Passport Office in Călărași issues an ID card.

Doinița Cebotari plays for Rapid Lviv, and Andreea is on CS Montreal. This is mostly for my own notes, to be honest. Jun isn't the owner of the red Dacia. Ilinca coaches Olimpia Tampere.

Mykola is treated by Emre and Layla is the doctor of Lucía. Hassan travels to Bălți. Priya works for Stan & Partners.

What I actually want to know: Honestly, is Georgiana Crăciun a parent of Chloe? Oliver gets the flu shot, and Samuel is vaccinated against the flu. So is Burak not vaccinated against the flu? I need to know if Jürgen teaches geography. Mr Saleh was based in Lyon on July 1, 2019, right? Besides Vasile Anghel, could you check who is the owner of the bakery on the corner?

Talk soon!
